hypothesis: After preserving the r5b checkpoint correction amplitude, CPADC offline training will receive a parent with sub-unit train-patch relative L2 instead of the prior approximately 6.06 corrupted parent.
mechanism: The parent correction branch remains at its learned scale 0.0285414904 rather than being amplified 35.04 times; CPADC then learns modes of the actual r5b residual distribution.
single_conceptual_change: Preserve the checkpoint correction amplitude when the legacy parent correction policy is enabled.
secondary_metric: best train-patch relative improvement after CPADC
failure_signal: The epoch-1 parent patch error is at least 1.0 or no epoch produces a nonnegative relative improvement.
rollback: Preserve the old CPADC checkpoints and reject this isolated output directory if the gate fails.
